verdict.rationale: AngelList claims you can move an existing cap table to Stack quickly. It also documents validation through automated Health Checks and reconciliation through the AI Tie Out Assistant, which flags mismatches between legal documents and the cap table. The guided import itself, from a spreadsheet or another platform, is only a one-line marketing claim. The update FAQ also says customers are being transitioned to other providers, which lowers confidence that onboarding is still available. Missing for 10: documented guided import workflow (spreadsheet templates or competitor-platform connectors), import-time validation details, independent or hands-on corroboration of migration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate an existing cap table — from a spreadsheet or another platform — with guided import, validation, and reconciliation against source documents

citations.quote: Move your cap table to Stack within minutes.
AngelList's Tie Out Assistant utilizes AI to identify potential mismatches between values in your legal documents and your cap table.
The Health Checks dashboard provides an overview of potential cap table inconsistencies that have been identified through automated system checks.
